funding.label: Council tax
funding.official_term: Council Tax (net of Council Tax Reduction)
funding.desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill, after Council Tax Reduction

funding.label: General Revenue Grant
funding.desc: The council's main general grant from the Scottish Government
